headline: **MLB Daily Recap: August 16, 2026**
article:
The Chicago White Sox edged the Detroit Tigers in a thrilling 4-3 victory, with Jordan Hicks earning the win after 1.2 scoreless innings of relief. Eduardo Valencia led the White Sox offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBIs.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their teams' lineups. Justin Sterner has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list by the Athletics due to right knee chondromalacia. The Los Angeles Dodgers placed Justin Wrobleski on the 15-day injured list with left forearm inflammation. Tyler Soderstrom has been placed on the 10-day injured list by the Athletics retroactive to August 15, 2026, due to left hip impingement. The Boston Red Sox have placed Masataka Yoshida on the 10-day injured list with a left hamstring strain and Justin Slaten on the 15-day injured list retroactive to August 13, 2026, due to right elbow inflammation.

Several trades and roster movements have taken place. The Athletics traded SS Jonathan Ornelas to the Milwaukee Brewers for cash. The Boston Red Sox traded CF Harold Rivas to the Baltimore Orioles as part of a player to be named later from the 8/3 Adley Rutschman trade.

top_news.title: **White Sox Edge Tigers in Thrilling 4-3 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox secured a narrow win over the Detroit Tigers, with Jordan Hicks earning the win after 1.2 scoreless innings of relief. Eduardo Valencia led the White Sox offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Take Down Cubs 8-4**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals secured an 8-4 victory over the Chicago Cubs, with Joshua Báez leading the offense with 3 hits, 3 home runs, and 5 RBIs. Michael McGreevy earned the win, pitching 6.0 innings with 6 strikeouts and 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Yankees Fall to Blue Jays 4-1**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays secured a 4-1 victory over the New York Yankees, with Spencer Miles earning the win. Charles McAdoo led the Yankees' offense with 2 hits and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Rockies Fall to Giants in One-Sided Affair**
top_news.summary: The San Francisco Giants dominated the Colorado Rockies 7-1, handing them a tough loss. Drew Gilbert led the Rockies' offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance.

top_news.title: **Orioles Rout Rays 10-2**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles dominated the Tampa Bay Rays in a lopsided 10-2 victory. Impact players for the Orioles included Jackson Holliday, Colton Cowser, Ryan Vilade, and Chandler Simpson, while Trevor Rogers stood out on the mound.

top_news.title: **Pirates Cruise Past Red Sox 8-3**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a decisive victory over the Boston Red Sox, winning 8-3. Connor Wong and Bryan Reynolds led the Pirates' offense, while Patrick Sandoval was a standout on the mound.

top_news.title: **Athletics RHP Justin Sterner Shifted to 60-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Justin Sterner has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a right knee chondromalacia diagnosis.

top_news.title: **Brewers Bolster Infield with Ornelas Acquisition**
top_news.summary: The Milwaukee Brewers have strengthened their infield with the addition of shortstop Jonathan Ornelas, acquired in a trade with the Athletics for cash.
